newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy seen issuing 36.5 trln lire BOTs.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy seen issuing 36.5 trln lire BOTs.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is expected on average to issue 36.5 trillion lire of short-term bills (Bot) at its end-month auction against 38.75 trillion lire worth of paper maturing, a Reuter poll of analysts showed.
Estimates range from 35.0 trillion lire to 37.5 trillion.
The Treasury is also expected to issue a new tranche of 2.0 trillion lire worth of zero coupon certificates (Ctz).
The Treasury will announce on Thursday the amount of paper it will offer at the Tuesday, November 26 auction. Settlement date is November 29.
Analysts said the Treasury was likely to maintain its policy seen over past months of issuing less new Bots than the amount maturing.

"The Treasury seems to be relying less on Bots and favouring medium to long-term debt. In this way Bots are again becoming a fund-raising instrument destined above all to smoothing out borrowing requirement fluctuations," one analyst said.
